violation_type.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(1)(A))
violation_type.short_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation
violation_type.typical_finding: The center director does not have proof of having completed orientation on file.

finding_variants.text: The center director does not have proof of having completed orientation on file.
At the time of inspection, annual training including infant training, CPR/First Aid certificates were not available for review.
Documentation was not available for review showing orientation was provided for the substitute caregivers.
Two staff did not have verification of complete orientation on file.
During an inspection on November 19, 2021  it was proven two caregivers who hired in the September 2021 did not receive their orientation training.
One employee file was missing orientation record.
